results.title: Examining the potential of Zakat in eradicating extreme poverty in ...
results.content: Therefore, this study aims to address a critical gap in the existing literature by empirically examining the concrete contributions of zakat in eradicating extreme poverty in Bangladesh, in alignment with Sustainable Development Goal 1.1. Moreover, research found that as a transparent and accountable form of Islamic social finance, zakat substantially contributes to poverty reduction, enabling wealth redistribution among marginalized communities and supporting the Sustainable Development Goals [15]. However, no empirical studies have yet investigated the specific role of Islamic social finance, particularly zakat, in poverty eradication within the context of Bangladesh. This study employs a cross-sectional survey to assess the impact of Islamic social finance, with a particular focus on zakat, in addressing extreme poverty in alignment with Sustainable Development Goal 1.1 in Bangladesh. The findings of this study indicate that zakat-based initiatives, as implemented through the self-reliant project of As-Sunnah Foundation, have a significant positive impact on reducing extreme poverty (SDG 1.1) among beneficiaries in Bangladesh.
